scheme_name: Sewing Machine Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
Monthly income of the applicant must not exceed ₹18,000.
The applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
The service period for the applicant is fixed at 2 years, and benefits are received after every five years of service.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹4,500 is provided to eligible women workers to purchase a sewing machine for domestic use.
